title: K-EndangeredBench: A Benchmark Dataset and Build Pipeline for Evaluating AI-Generated Content on Korean Endangered Species
description: Record set pairing Korean national endangered-species designations (Class I/II under Annex 1 of the Enforcement Rule of the Wildlife Protection and Management Act, as amended 2022-12-09) with IUCN Red List categories, GBIF taxonomic and occurrence facts, and BonV Lab ecology-card narratives, for measuring factual accuracy and hallucination in AI-generated science education content. Includes the 282-taxon statutory census in the same schema.
